comparison.objective: Support a bar before withdrawing its carriage; candidate tunes an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support and relative carriage withdrawal versus tool alignment, collar rotation, locking, and iterative impact inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Alternate support continuously carries the bar and carriage gains real clearance versus two safe stops within the damper envelope. Bar record lacks numeric clearance/support thresholds.
comparison.reason: Load transfer and withdrawal are meaningfully different from damper commissioning.
